# mtncloud_deployment (Resource)

A deployment (Provisioning > Deployments): a named application whose versions (`mtncloud_deployment_version`) are deployed to instances with `mtncloud_instance_deploy`. Destroying it deletes its versions too; what was deployed stays on the instances.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mtncloud_deployment" "web" {
  name        = "web-site"
  description = "The public web site"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name, unique in the tenant. Changed in place.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description. Leave it out for none. Changed in place.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID of the deployment.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The deployment's ID.
terraform import mtncloud_deployment.web <deployment_id>
```
